cohort: 116 pediatric patients admitted with LRTIs at a tertiary care teaching hospital in Hyderabad, India
finding: Children under 1 year old were most vulnerable to LRTIs, with cough and fever being the most common symptoms; bronchopneumonia was the most frequent LRTI, and amoxicillin with clavulanic acid was the most common treatment, resulting in a satisfactory outcome with negligible morbidity and no mortality.
